title: game/data/perkSets.json: Perk sets (perks track PK-8): holding `need` of a set's Perks (those tagged with its id in perks.json) adds its effect rows to the run (logic/effects.js fxOfRun, src set:<id>)

name.description: the set's name, as its Perks' cards show it ("Office Supplies 2/3")

title.description: the bonus's name, what the player earns ("Middle Management"); battle lines name the set by it

need.description: how many of its Perks must be held for the bonus (2 to 6; data-checks.js: no more than it has)

d.description: what the bonus does, in one sentence

fx.description: the bonus's effect rows, as a Perk's (perks.schema.json)
